articles.title: What we know so far about the Berlin Pride ramming attack
articles.description: A police manhunt is underway after a suspect rammed a car into a crowd at a Pride event in the German capital on Saturday night.
articles.titleJa: ベルリンのプライドイベントでの車両突入攻撃について、これまでに分かっていること
articles.summary: ベルリンのプライドイベントで車両が群衆に突入。警察が容疑者の捜索を続ける中、この事件が社会に与える影響が懸念されている。

articles.title: France battles fire 'whirlwinds' as another 55,000 evacuated
articles.description: More than 340,000 people have now been evacuated from wildfires in France and Spain.
articles.titleJa: フランス、火災の「旋風」と闘い、さらに5万5千人が避難
articles.summary: フランスとスペインで山火事が猛威を振るい、5万5千人が追加で避難。これまでに34万人以上が避難を余儀なくされている。

articles.title: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
articles.description: The event celebrated press freedom after the first dinner was cancelled by a shooting in April.
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏、ホワイトハウス記者会食で報道陣を批判
articles.summary: ホワイトハウス記者会食で、トランプ前大統領が報道の自由を巡り報道陣を批判した。このイベントは4月の銃撃事件で中止された後、初めて開催された。

articles.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
articles.description: The latest attacks come two days after a clash between settlers and Palestinians near the village of Tell, which left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead.
articles.titleJa: パレスチナ人によると、イスラエル人入植者がヨルダン川西岸でモスク、車、農地に放火
articles.summary: ヨルダン川西岸で、イスラエル人入植者がモスクや農地などに放火したとパレスチナ人が報告。以前の衝突で双方に死者が出ており、緊張が高まっている。

articles.title: India's 'cockroach' protest called off after education minister quits
articles.description: The CJP protest has been the most visible expression of public anger against PM Narendra Modi's government in recent years.
articles.titleJa: インドの「ゴキブリ」抗議デモ、教育大臣辞任で中止
articles.summary: インドで「ゴキブリ」と称された抗議デモが、教育大臣の辞任を受けて中止された。これはモディ政権に対する国民の怒りの最も目に見える表現だった。

articles.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
articles.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.
articles.titleJa: ロシアによるキーウ近郊のドローン展示会攻撃で10人死亡
articles.summary: キーウ近郊のドローン展示会がロシアの弾道ミサイル攻撃を受け、ウクライナ国防産業の主要人物を含む10人が死亡した。

articles.title: Zelensky tries to fix crisis over removal of defence minister and counts the cost
articles.description: Protests have continued over Zelensky's decision to dismiss Mykhailo Fedorov, and some commentators believe he has been damaged politically.
articles.titleJa: ゼレンスキー氏、国防大臣解任を巡る危機を収拾し、その代償を測る
articles.summary: ゼレンスキー大統領がミハイロ・フェドロフ国防大臣の解任を巡る危機に対処中。この決定は彼の政治的評価に打撃を与えたとの見方がある。

articles.title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
articles.description: US military says it disabled a tanker that was attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports.
articles.titleJa: イラン支援のフーシ派、サウジアラビアへのミサイル攻撃を主張
articles.summary: イランが支援するフーシ派がサウジアラビアへのミサイル攻撃を主張。米軍はイランの封鎖を回避しようとしたタンカーを無力化したと発表した。

articles.title: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
articles.description: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.
articles.titleJa: ヨルダン川西岸でパレスチナ人4人とイスラエル人2人が射殺される
articles.summary: ヨルダン川西岸での銃撃事件で、パレスチナ人4人とイスラエル人2人が死亡。パレスチナ側は入植者による襲撃を、イスラエル軍はパレスチナ人による発砲を主張している。

articles.title: ICC top prosecutor removed over sexual misconduct allegations
articles.description: Karim Khan denies allegations of engaging in an improper sexual relationship with a junior ICC staff member and seeking to stop her pursuing her complaint.
articles.titleJa: 国際刑事裁判所（ICC）の主任検察官、性的不品行の疑惑で解任
articles.summary: 国際刑事裁判所（ICC）の主任検察官が、性的不品行の疑惑で解任された。本人は疑惑を否定している。

articles.title: Can Pakistan-administered Kashmir elections calm tensions?
articles.description: Pakistan-administered Kashmir heads to the polls after weeks of deadly protests over seats reserved for displaced people from India-administered Kashmir. One local group has called for the elections to be boycotted.
articles.titleJa: パキスタン支配下のカシミール選挙は緊張を和らげるか？
articles.summary: パキスタン支配下のカシミールで、インド支配下のカシミールからの避難民の議席を巡る抗議活動が数週間続いた後、選挙が実施されます。一部の地元団体は選挙のボイコットを呼びかけています。

articles.title: Sudan civil war: Civilians used as 'human shields'
articles.description: The situation in the besieged city of El Obeid in Sudan is worsening by the day, with rights organizations warning of mass atrocities. Children are traumatized and do not dare go to school.
articles.titleJa: スーダン内戦：市民が「人間の盾」として利用される
articles.summary: スーダンの包囲された都市エル・オベイドでは状況が日々悪化しており、人権団体は大規模な残虐行為を警告しています。子どもたちはトラウマを抱え、学校に行くこともできません。

articles.title: Middle East: No fresh US strikes on Iran for a second day
articles.description: Two days have passed without any strikes by the US and Iran. Fighting between Yemen's Houthis and Saudi Arabia has added another layer to the complex Middle East crisis. DW has the latest.
articles.titleJa: 中東：米国によるイランへの新たな攻撃は2日なし
articles.summary: 米国とイランの間で2日間攻撃がなく、イエメンのフーシ派とサウジアラビア間の戦闘が中東の複雑な危機に新たな層を加えています。

articles.title: Vietnamese vessel sinks in South China Sea, 23 missing
articles.description: A Vietnamese-registered cargo ship carrying 62 crew members sank near Yongshu Reef in the South China Sea, one of the world's most important and contested maritime spaces.
articles.titleJa: 南シナ海でベトナム船が沈没、23人行方不明
articles.summary: 南シナ海の永暑礁付近で、ベトナム船籍の貨物船が沈没し、乗組員62名のうち23名が行方不明となっています。ここは世界で最も重要かつ係争の多い海域の一つです。

articles.title: Berlin CSD: Latest in string of deadly vehicle attacks
articles.description: The attack at a Berlin Pride event is only the most recent incident on a long list where vehicles were used as weapons. The US, Canada, and China also saw similar attacks in recent years.
articles.titleJa: ベルリンCSD：車両を使った死亡攻撃が続く最新事例
articles.summary: ベルリンのプライドイベントでの攻撃は、車両が武器として使われた事件の長いリストの中で最新のものです。米国、カナダ、中国でも近年同様の攻撃がありました。

articles.title: India news: Home minister backs Pradhan after resignation
articles.description: Hours after India's education minister resigned amid youth protests, India's home minister spoke out in his defense. Meanwhile, Cockroach party's leader thanked 'cockroaches' across India. DW has more.
articles.titleJa: インドニュース：内務大臣、プラダン氏辞任後も支持
articles.summary: インドの教育大臣が若者の抗議を受けて辞任した数時間後、インドの内務大臣が彼を擁護しました。また、「ゴキブリ党」の党首は全国の「ゴキブリ」に感謝を述べました。

articles.title: Germany launches manhunt after Berlin Pride van ramming
articles.description: Police believe the 21-year-old suspect, named as Abdul B., has links to the Islamist scene. One person was killed and several others injured in the attack. Follow DW for more.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ、ベルリンのプライドイベントでのバン突入事件後、容疑者の大規模捜索を開始
articles.summary: 警察は、21歳の容疑者アブドゥル・Bがイスラム過激派グループと関係があると見ています。この攻撃で1人が死亡し、数人が負傷しました。

articles.title: Brazil denies entry to senior Trump officials ahead of elections
articles.description: Brazil rejected visas for two planned US envoys, alleging that Washington was seeking to shape Brazil's upcoming presidential election. The development adds to a deepening political tension between Brazil and the US.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、選挙を前にトランプ政権高官の入国を拒否
articles.summary: ブラジルは、米国がブラジルの次期大統領選挙に影響を与えようとしていると主張し、米国特使2人へのビザ発給を拒否しました。これにより、両国間の政治的緊張が深まっています。

articles.title: Berlin: 1 dead, 16 injured after car ramming at CSD Pride event
articles.description: A citywide manhunt is underway after a van drove into a crowd during Pride celebrations, known locally as Christopher Street Day (CSD). Police have identified a suspect tied to Berlin's "Islamist scene."
articles.titleJa: ベルリン：CSDプライドイベントでの車両突入により1名死亡、16名負傷
articles.summary: プライドイベント中にバンが群衆に突入した事件後、市内全域で犯人捜索が行われています。警察はベルリンの「イスラム過激派グループ」に関連する容疑者を特定しました。

articles.title: WAFCON 2026: What you need to know
articles.description: Several months after it was supposed to start and with more teams than first planned, WAFCON 2026 is finally set to begin. The hosts want a maiden title while a tournament outsider have one of its best players.
articles.titleJa: WAFCON 2026：知っておくべきこと
articles.summary: 数か月遅れて、WAFCON 2026がついに開催されます。開催国は初のタイトルを狙い、トーナメントのダークホースは最高の選手の一人を擁しています。

articles.title: Two Russian men jailed in Angola for terrorism and spying
articles.description:
The men were convicted over alleged plan to stage coup and organise deadly demonstrations over fuel prices last year
Two Russian men have been found guilty by an Angolan court of terrorism and spying after being accused of planning a coup and helping to organise deadly demonstrations in the southern African country last year.
Lev Lakshtanov and Igor Ratchin were sentenced to eight and 11 years in jail respectively. They had denied the charges, claiming they were in Angola for cultural and business activities.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アンゴラでテロとスパイ行為によりロシア人2人が投獄
articles.summary: アンゴラの裁判所は、昨年クーデターを計画し、デモを組織したとしてロシア人2人にテロとスパイ行為の有罪判決を下し、それぞれ8年と11年の禁固刑を言い渡した。

articles.title: MoD cancels army training in Kenya over powers to prosecute British soldiers
articles.description:
September exercise called off after Kenya raises concerns over funding and jurisdiction for criminal offences
The British army has been forced to cancel training for its troops in Kenya after the Kenyan government refused to ratify a bilateral defence agreement.
While the UK government wanted to renew the existing agreement, Kenyan lawmakers had sought changes to give local authorities greater powers to hold British soldiers accountable for any offences committed in the country.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 英国防省、英兵訴追権限を巡りケニアでの陸軍訓練を中止
articles.summary: ケニア政府が二国間防衛協定の批准を拒否したため、英陸軍はケニアでの訓練中止を余儀なくされた。ケニアは英兵の犯罪行為に対する地元当局の権限強化を求めている。

articles.title: Health worker monitored for Ebola in London hospital after working in DRC
articles.description:
UK resident was evacuated from Democratic Republic of the Congo where there is an outbreak of the disease
A humanitarian worker is being monitored at a specialist hospital in London after potential exposure to the Ebola virus.
The UK resident was medically evacuated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) where the worker had been treating patients with the disease, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) said.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: DRCでの勤務後、ロンドンの病院でエボラウイルス感染の医療従事者を監視
articles.summary: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でエボラ患者を治療していた英国人援助活動家が、エボラウイルスに曝露した可能性があり、ロンドンの専門病院で監視下にある。

articles.title: Healthy diet too expensive for one in three people globally, UN report finds
articles.description:
Global hunger declined for the third year in a row in 2025 but experts call for action to bring down costs of fruit, vegetables and dairy as report shows 2.69bn people can’t afford to eat well
One in three people cannot afford to eat a healthy diet, a new report has found, prompting calls for urgent action on food affordability.
There are 2.69 billion people unable to afford a diverse diet that meets their energy and nutrient needs, and it will take “immense” amounts of work to achieve the global target of zero hunger by 2030, the annual report from five UN agencies warned.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 世界の3人に1人が健康的な食事を摂るには費用が高すぎると国連報告書
articles.summary: 国連の報告書によると、世界人口の3人に1人、約26.9億人が健康的な食事を摂る余裕がなく、食料の費用低下に向けた緊急対策が求められている。

articles.title: São Tomé and Príncipe heads to polls in tense presidential election
articles.description:
Incumbent Carlos Vila Nova hopes to defeat his former party and secure second term as independent
Voters in São Tomé and Príncipe go to the polls for a presidential election on Sunday as one of Africa’s least populous countries seeks to burnish its democratic credentials.
According to the National Election Commission, about 142,000 people are registered to vote in the tiny African state’s elections, approximately 15% of whom live in the diaspora.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: サントメ・プリンシペ、緊迫した大統領選挙へ
articles.summary: アフリカの小国サントメ・プリンシペで大統領選挙が行われ、現職のカルロス・ビラ・ノバ氏が独立候補として2期目を目指す。約14.2万人が有権者登録をしている。

articles.title: Venezuela men sue aviation firms who flew them to notorious Salvadorian jail
articles.description:
Exclusive: CSI Aviation and GlobalX accused of violating civil rights as part of Trump immigration crackdown
Venezuelan men sent last year to a notorious Salvadorian terrorism prison by the Trump administration are suing the US aviation companies that transported them there.
A lawsuit filed this week in federal court in Washington DC accuses the companies CSI Aviation and GlobalX of violating the Venezuelans’ civil rights, false imprisonment, intentional infliction of emotional distress, negligence and other violations, for their role in flying the three planes that took the men to El Salvador.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ人男性、悪名高いエルサルバドルの刑務所に送った航空会社を提訴
articles.summary: トランプ政権下でエルサルバドルのテロ刑務所に送られたベネズエラ人男性たちが、彼らを輸送した米国の航空会社を市民権侵害などで提訴した。訴訟はワシントンDCの連邦裁判所で起こされた。

articles.title: Thousands of lightning strikes trigger fresh wildfires in western Canada
articles.description:
At least 90 active blazes in British Columbia in what PM says is one of the country’s most intense seasons on record

How dangerous are wildfires and how can we stop them from getting worse?

Fresh wildfires have broken out in western Canada and forests continued to ⁠burn in Ontario as the country ⁠battled what the prime ​minister, Mark Carney, called one of the most intense wildfire seasons on record.
Nearly 34,000 lightning strikes over the past week led to a series of fires ⁠and evacuation orders in southern British Columbia. There were 25 evacuation orders and 90 active wildfires in the province as of Friday morning, and authorities said warming ⁠and drying conditions could cause them to grow.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: カナダ西部で数千回の落雷が新たな森林火災を引き起こす
articles.summary: カナダ西部で過去1週間で約3.4万回の落雷があり、ブリティッシュコロンビア州を中心に新たな森林火災が多数発生。今年度の森林火災シーズンは過去最も激しいものの一つとされている。

articles.title: Guyanese authorities confirm death of 72 people in sinking of coastal ferry
articles.description:
Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 were rescued as efforts continue to salvage the ship and recover all bodies
The confirmed death toll from the recent capsizing of a state ferry off Guyana’s coast has risen to 72, with more bodies recovered as a multinational team struggle to salvage the partially submerged vessel.
Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 people were rescued. The government has estimated that 100 may have died in the accident, which would make it the worst marine tragedy on record for the South American nation.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ガイアナ当局、沿岸フェリー沈没で72人の死亡を確認
articles.summary: ガイアナ沖で発生したフェリー沈没事故で、死者数が72人に達した。乗船していた約179人のうち76人が救助されたが、南米国家にとって史上最悪の海難事故となる可能性がある。

articles.title: Canadian government urged to block Thomson Reuters data deal with US ICE
articles.description:
US agency is to pay Canadian media company US$125m for use of investigative database to detect ‘immigration fraud’
A Canadian federal opposition party leader has called on Mark Carney’s government to block the latest data-sharing deal between US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and the Canadian media company Thomson Reuters.
Avi Lewis, the federal leader of the New Democratic party (NDP), demanded on Tuesday that Ottawa address the contract and further restrict Canadian corporations from doing business with ICE, after Canada’s National Observer news website reported on the deal.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: カナダ政府、トムソン・ロイターと米ICEのデータ取引阻止を要請される
articles.summary: カナダの野党党首が、カナダ政府に対し、トムソン・ロイターが米国移民関税執行局（ICE）に捜査用データベースを提供する契約を阻止するよう求めた。

articles.title: Masked men invading and taking Amazon communities ‘hostage’ in organised crime surge, say local leaders
articles.description:
Delegation sent to Brasília after gunmen from organised crime group enter homes in western Amazon
Indigenous leaders on the Brazilian-Peruvian border have said their communities are being “taken hostage” by organised crime groups who are running rampant across the region, destroying rainforest, building roads and trafficking drugs.
Earlier this month, masked men armed with semi-automatic weapons entered homes in Apiwtxa, a village in the Kampa do Rio Amônia Indigenous territory, intimidating people and searching for targets.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: マスクを被った男たちがアマゾン地域を侵略し「人質」に、組織犯罪が急増
articles.summary: ブラジルとペルー国境のアマゾン地域で、組織犯罪集団が先住民コミュニティを「人質」に取り、森林破壊や麻薬密売を行っていると地元リーダーが報告。武装した男たちが家々に侵入する事件も発生。

articles.title: Ukraine strikes Russian Iran-bound cargo as Iran war widens
articles.description: Ukraine says it has struck long-range routes moving Russian military equipment linked to Iran, while Zelensky claims Moscow gave Tehran satellite data for attacks on US sites in the Middle East.
articles.titleJa: ウクライナがイラン行きロシア貨物を攻撃、イラン戦争が拡大
articles.summary: ウクライナはイラン行きロシア軍事装備を攻撃。ゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアが中東の米軍施設攻撃のためイランに衛星データを提供したと主張しており、紛争の拡大が懸念される。

articles.title: Russian strikes across Ukraine kill at least eight over last 24 hours
articles.description: Ukrainian authorities also reported an attack on a shopping centre in Kryvyi Rih on Sunday. A fire reportedly broke out at an Epitsentr DIY store following the strike.
articles.titleJa: ロシアのウクライナ全土への攻撃により過去24時間で少なくとも8人死亡
articles.summary: ロシア軍によるウクライナ全土への攻撃で過去24時間に少なくとも8人が死亡。クリヴィー・リフのショッピングセンターも攻撃され、火災が発生した。

articles.title: Eurostar is launching a new direct route from London to Antwerp this December
articles.description: The new route will  allow travellers to skip the transfer in Brussels –  but you won’t be able to take a direct return on the way back.
articles.titleJa: ユーロスター、ロンドンからアントワープへの新直通路線を今年12月に開設
articles.summary: ユーロスターが今年12月にロンドンとアントワープを結ぶ新しい直通路線を開設。ブリュッセルでの乗り換えが不要になるが、復路は直通便がない。

articles.title: Mount Olympus and D-Day beaches added to UNESCO World Heritage List
articles.description: Greece's mythical mountain, Normandy's D-Day beaches and Japan's ancient capitals are among the latest sites recognised by UNESCO for their outstanding universal value.
articles.titleJa: オリンポス山とDデイのビーチがユネスコ世界遺産リストに追加
articles.summary: ギリシャのオリンポス山、ノルマンディーのDデイのビーチ、日本の古都などが、ユネスコの世界遺産リストにその普遍的価値を認められ追加された。

articles.title: Latest news bulletin | July 26th, 2026 – Midday
articles.description: Catch up with the most important stories from around Europe and beyond this July 26th, 2026 - latest news, breaking news, World, Business, Entertainment, Politics, Culture, Travel.
articles.titleJa: 最新ニュース速報 | 2026年7月26日 – 正午
articles.summary: 2026年7月26日正午の最新ニュース速報。ヨーロッパおよび世界中の重要な出来事を、ビジネス、エンターテイメント、政治、文化、旅行など幅広い分野からお届けする。

articles.title: Pedro Sánchez: "The scale of the disaster we are living through is very hard to accept"
articles.description: The joint appearance by the unified command tackling the fires in Madrid, Ávila and Toledo and the prime minister underlined close cooperation. They urge the public to focus on prevention and act with caution.
articles.titleJa: ペドロ・サンチェス：「私たちが経験している災害の規模は受け入れがたい」
articles.summary: マドリード、アビラ、トレドでの火災に対処する統合司令部とスペイン首相の共同会見。首相は、火災の規模が非常に深刻であり、国民に予防と注意を促した。

articles.title: Italy petrol tops €2.6: opposition and groups sound alarm, govt weighs variable fuel duty
articles.description: Fuel costs are back in the spotlight: in Milan and on motorways prices exceed €2.60 a litre. Opposition parties and associations warn of hikes hitting families and firms, while the Meloni government drafts measures to stem the crisis.
articles.titleJa: イタリアのガソリン価格が2.6ユーロ超え：野党と団体が警鐘、政府は変動燃料税を検討
articles.summary: イタリアでガソリン価格が1リットルあたり2.6ユーロを超え、ミラノや高速道路で高騰。野党や団体が家計への影響を警告し、メローニ政権は価格抑制策を検討している。

articles.title: 'Sea cannibal' spreads across the Baltic, threatening native species

articles.title: Why is transit in goods free but trade is not?

While these negotiations will reduce trade protection, they will not necessarily lead to free trade. But if governments do not generally commit themselves to free trade, why has freedom of transit for goods been seen differently?

articles.title: Fertilizer trade impacted by Strait of Hormuz conflict
articles.description: Trade in urea and phosphate fertilizers has been severely disrupted by the conflict in the Persian Gulf, according to data analysed by the WTO Secretariat. Certain economies in Africa and Asia are particularly vulnerable to resulting fertilizer shortages and price hikes. Opening of the Strait of Hormuz – a key channel for fertilizer trade - will in due course contribute to easing trade frictions and restore stability to global markets.
